I did not run the full vitest suite, typecheck, build, Biome or verify (gate rows), and the source tree is untouched (still exactly the 7 granted modified files).

A and the reviewer rated it Medium; I rate it Low because the patch was dispatched byte-for-byte, nothing user-visible changes, and 14/14 mutants are red. A fix would assert `muted[0].name === 'Group 2'`.
